title: After the Satsuki Sho: Surpassing You, Touching the Ring

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will forge that circle... without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Rose & Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!
Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“Rose Kingdom crosses the wire!
A magnificent triumph in the Satsuki
Sho!!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The first crown...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I have accomplished it...!
This shall become the glory of my clan...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
...It is frustrating, yes,
but even more than that—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I am delighted.
Delighted that a race with you
could ignite such fervent passion.
Just look—!
(Woooooaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“She did it! Congrats, Rose!”
“Pisaaa!” “You were amazing!”
“What a fierce clash!
That totally brought me to tears!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That was way too intense! Ah, sorry,
I put my arm around you!"
"No worries, I'm thrilled too!"
"Racing really is the absolute best,
isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A staggering 'frenzy'—no.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So this is the 'ring'...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...At the Nippon Derby,
I am sure we can create an even greater
circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to your guidance on that
grand stage as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes—likewise.
Let us face this with complete resolve.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though victory was mine to claim,
without her,
that 'circle' would never have been
formed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Nothing is quite so arduous
as forging connections between things
unseen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The way she lived her life brought forth
that 'circle.'
Her unswerving resolve is what made it so.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While she was already a friend I held
in high esteem,
those sentiments have deepened all the
more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The next race is—the Japanese Derby,
is it?

I nod at the question.
The second leg of the Classic Triple
Crown.
A 2,400-meter turf battle held at Tokyo
Racecourse—
choice_data_list: This is the battle to determine th...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I will be facing Pisa once more.
No, she will not be the only formidable
rival gathered there.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The title of “Derby Umamusume” is a dazzling
crown of glory.
One for which every runner wagers their very
soul on the turf.
choice_data_list: Let's analyze the race footage and...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the moment we return to the academy.
—We shall claim the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Flash-san, you're still awake?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've been going to bed at 11 o'clock sharp
lately though~
Did you change your schedule by any
chance?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have pushed back my bedtime by 60
minutes.
At my current pace,
it seemed unlikely I would finish in time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho—
running shoulder-to-shoulder with them made
me realize:
my rivals are formidable,
even compared to typical years—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We must factor these variables into our
recalculations and face the challenge with
flawless preparation.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see! ...It'd be wonderful if you could
show it to the father and mother you respect
so deeply.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The sight of her winning the Japanese
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes—without fail.

Every single one of them,
aiming for that pinnacle—

They forged ahead,
racing toward their next race:
the Japanese Derby.
